flows.title: See a summary of ad performance on the Dashboard
steps: Click the Dashboard page from the top navigation bar in TikTok Ads Manager.

Read the summary: Recommendations, Ad group status (active, partially delivering, not delivering), Performance as a trend, Insights on top-performing ads and audiences, and the Log of operations on the account.
Click the Calendar icon to filter the date and time of the performance metrics.

flows.title: See the results of a campaign, ad group or ad
steps: Click the Campaigns page from the top navigation bar in TikTok Ads Manager.
Click the Campaign, Ad group or Ad tab.
Scroll down or use the search bar to find the campaign, ad group or ad.
Scroll to the right to view the default column metrics. To change them, click the Custom table dropdown on the top-right and choose a performance template, the Setup metrics, or Custom Columns.
In the same dropdown, Breakdown shows the metrics by Day, Week or Month, and its Compare toggle compares two date ranges.
For deeper daily metrics on one item, hover over it and click the View data icon (View report for some customers).
To export, click the three dots on the top right and click Export data.
